text_block_list.text:
With an unusually serious look on her face,
Oguri Cap asked to extend her training session.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
With everyone at the academy running so hard...
No, even more than that, I want to work up a sweat myself.
choice_data_list: What's wrong all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Everyone at this academy runs so much.
Even at this very moment."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Maybe going that far is the only way
to survive in the Central League.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't think things can stay the way they are.
To beat everyone, training is the only way.
choice_data_list: I hear your resolve loud and clear!
Don't get thrown off by someone else's pace.
Don't let other people's pace throw you off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't think things can stay the way they are.
To beat everyone, training is the only way.
choice_data_list: I hear your resolve loud and clear!
Don't get thrown off by someone else's pace.
Don't let other people's pace throw you off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see. Thank you.
I'll put my heart into it as well.

True to her word, Oguri Cap stayed focused
and trained for the entire allotted time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Am I being thrown off by someone else's pace right now?
choice_data_list: Oguri has her own way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's... true enough. All right.
We'll call it a day for now.

She seemed satisfied in her own way,
nodding occasionally as she walked away...
